title: Procgen region library
description: A user-selectable library of pre-built region descriptors loadable from JSON (CC/docs/plans/region-library-plan.md §2a). One file = one library; each entry is a captured region addressable as (library_id, entry_id) and instantiable by the shuffled-spiral driver as a content source ('library:<library_id>'). The cross-reference rules this schema cannot express (unique entry_id, the per-substrate capture contract, content-hash identity, capability-vs-payload) are enforced authoritatively by frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/regionLibraryValidator.js.

library_id.description: Stamped content-hash id; ends with '-<content_hash>'. Selection/caches key on it, so an edited document must be restamped.

content_hash.description: FNV-1a over the canonical (sorted-key) document minus provenance and library_id; library_id must end with '-<content_hash>'. Restamp with region-library-validate.mjs --restamp after a hand edit.

entry_id.description: Unique within the file, author-chosen, stable across restamps (selections/provenance survive edits).

substrate.description: The runtime substrate an instantiated region carries (v1: 'maze' or 'bounce'). Routes panelComponentType/loadRegionEvent.

region_size.description: Required for tile (procedural) substrates like maze; the nominal region grid the payload realises into.

exit_sides.description: Sides this entry can offer as exits. A slot fits iff its required sides are a subset (surplus sides are walled off).

payload.description: adapter.serializeWorld output (sidecar form). For procedural substrates this is the sole stored artifact — rules re-derive on instantiate.

carried_rules.description: Null for procedural substrates (rules re-derived); the emitted exits/locations/paths + obstacle_defs verbatim for content substrates whose geometry cannot be re-derived.

location_slots.description: How many AP location slots this entry offers for the engine to place items on.
